HKDiscreteQuantitySample else { fatalError("*** Unexpected Sample Type ***") } // Check to see if the sample is a series. if sample.count == 1 { // This is a single sample. // Use the sample. myOutput.append("\(sample)\n") } else { // This is a series. // Get the detailed items for the series. myGetDetailedItems(for: sample) } } } ```
